comment: Closure budgets for the concrete headless hosts the operator actually runs. fleet/server-profile.json budgets the exported 'server' capability contract, which excludes development and containers and therefore never covers these machines; without this file their growth is unmeasured. Desktop and WSL hosts are deliberately absent: the desktop carries games and DAWs whose size is not a regression signal, and the WSL host is a thin control plane. checks/fleet/host-closure.nix prints the measured numbers on every run, so tightening a ceiling never requires guessing.
